name: (02) Thaumaturgy (Path of the Focused Mind) — 1 Basic — Centering

system.description: By speaking soothing words to herself or a target, the thaumaturge influences a person's psyche, even helping to fend off frenzy. For the duration, the target ignores wound penalties, and for every Mental Trait the caster spends (up to three), the target gains a Trait to resist attempts to evoke emotion or break frenzy, even those from Disciplines. The target must be able to hear the caster speaking for at least one full turn. This power lasts one scene or an hour.
